tape1_living.title: Tape 1 — Noa and Mom
tape1_living.lines:
Noa: "Do you remember what happened after the third knock?"
Miriam: "I remember what I did."
Noa: "That's not the same thing."
Miriam: "No. It isn't."
[a chair drags. four seconds of silence.]
Miriam: "If Eitan comes back, don't tell him what you think. Let him see."

study_tapes.title: Study tapes (2 of 3)
study_tapes.lines:
[Tape A — storm, a distant argument, three knocks, long silence.]
[Tape B — Yoav, tired:] "...reset the rear lock. The door wasn't forced from outside. I heard them — from inside."
[The third slot is empty.]

last_tape.title: Last tape — do not rewind
last_tape.lines:
[Heavy rain. Pipe noise. Three distant knocks.]
A man's voice, faint: "I know you're in there."
[Long silence.]
Another voice, barely audible: "Don't open."
[The tape cuts before either voice can be named.]

storm_full.title: Storm-night recorder
storm_full.lines:
[Full night: wind rising, gutters, a slammed door far away.]
 Raised voices — too far to separate.
[Storm peak. Then, clearly, three knocks.]
[Silence. Only rain. Then the same sequence again — fainter, unsynced, as if the house itself remembered it wrong.]
